longTitle.officialTitle: To eliminate unnecessary reporting requirements for unfunded programs under the Office of Justice Programs.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Reporting Efficiency Improvement Act”.

section.heading: ELIMINATION OF REPORTS FOR UNFUNDED PROGRAMS UNDER THE OFFICE OF JUSTICE PROGRAMS.

subsection.heading: DNA Identification Grants.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 2406 of title I of the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 3796kk-5) is amended—

paragraph.content: by striking “(a) Reports to Attorney General.—”; and

paragraph.heading: Repeal of report requirement.—
paragraph.content: Section 200113 of the Police Corps Act (42 U.S.C. 14102) is repealed.

paragraph.heading: Conforming amendment.—
paragraph.content: The Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994 is amended by striking the item relating to section 200113 in the table of contents contained in section 2 of such Act.
